en: Convoy raid

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: a Combine convoy of 3 or 4 freighters and tankers is due through this water under a corvette escort. Mission: sink or disable 60% of its tonnage. Execution: close unseen, strike the merchants and break off before the escort can pin you. A raided lane stays cut for 10 days and patrols thin across the region.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Depot strike

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the depot hulk moored here holds fuel and munitions for the region's patrols. A harbour garrison guards her and a task group lies close by. Mission: destroy the depot. Execution: come in from seaward, fire on the hulk and withdraw west. An empty depot cuts every lane it feeds for 10 days.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Radar decapitation

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: a coastal radar site covers the approaches to this sector. Mission: destroy the site. Execution: by gunfire from close inshore, or put a landing party ashore by RHIB. Keep emissions down on the run in; the operators listen as well as transmit.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Agent extraction

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: two agents are waiting at the landing marked on the chart. Combine patrols work this coast. Mission: embark both and leave by the exit. Execution: hold under 3 kn within 100 m of the landing for 60 s while the RHIB brings them off. Lose no one.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Minelaying

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: Combine traffic in this area runs along one swept lane. Mission: lay 6 mines across the lane at the marked point. Execution: hold within 5° of the line's course at 6 kn or more while the rails drop a mine every 50 m. The field stays on the lane and cuts it.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Prize capture

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: a freighter is on passage through this area with a corvette escort. Mission: take her as a prize. Execution: stop her engines, come alongside under 5 kn within 200 m and hold for 90 s while the boarding team takes her bridge. Fire on either ship aborts the boarding.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Defector escort

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the crew of a Combine patrol boat means to defect and will wait at the rendezvous. Treat her as neutral until you meet. Mission: take her 3 officers aboard and bring her out by the exit. Execution: meet her, embark the officers and shield her from the pursuit. A task group is already searching.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Feint

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: a Combine task group is working this area. Mission: draw it off, hold its attention for 5 minutes, then escape. Execution: let them detect you, keep the range open and lead them away from the real work elsewhere. Drones and decoys buy time.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Photo reconnaissance

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: intelligence needs current photographs of the Combine hulls at the objective. Mission: photograph 3 of them. Execution: hold each target in the camera's field of view, inside 6 km and in visual line of sight, for 20 s. Do not open fire.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Survive the hunter group

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: a Combine hunter-killer group has found SEXTANT. Mission: survive 15 minutes and break contact by the exit. Execution: use the weather, the islands, decoys and emission control. Do not fight the group head on.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Cutting out

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: a Combine hull lies at her berth in this anchorage, under the harbour guns and a garrison. Mission: cut her out and sail her to the exit. Execution: go in shallow and quiet, board her at the berth and bring her out under her own power.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: Blind Crane Head

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: Crane Head radar watches every approach to the western Gannet Banks. While it stands, SEXTANT cannot shift coves unseen. Mission: destroy the radar site. Execution: approach from the west under emission control, engage the site and clear out before the task group from Port Ollan can close. Afterwards SEXTANT's yard can fit tier 2 parts.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: Kessel toll

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: every convoy from Fenwick yard to the northern depots passes Kessel Gap, and the next one sails under a heavy escort. A Combine captain called the Auditor commands in these waters. Mission: sink or disable three quarters of the convoy's tonnage. Execution: strike in the Gap, then clear the area. Cut here, the north starves. Afterwards SEXTANT's yard can fit tier 3 parts.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: Quiet hand

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the Mareby harbour pilot keeps the charts of the Combine's swept channels and wants out with two of her family. Mission: embark all three at the landing and leave by the exit. Execution: go in at night if you can, hold at the landing for the boat and lose no one.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: The Bursar's berth

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the supply tender that keeps Port Ollan's groups at sea lies at her berth inside the base. A captain called the Bailiff has arrived with a frigate. Mission: board the tender and sail her out by the exit. Execution: draw under 2.5 m, go in quiet and keep clear of the frigate.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: Closing the account

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the Auditor's ship, Arrears, is working this area with a missile group. She hunts silent and closes fast. Mission: sink or disable Arrears. Execution: deny her a firing solution, then catch her inside gun range. Taken intact she is worth more.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: Served notice

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the Bailiff's frigate, Covenant, leads an escort group here. She outranges anything LANTERN carries. Mission: sink or disable Covenant. Execution: use weather and islands to close unseen. Her escorts will try to hold you at range.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: Breakwater

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: Port Ollan is the last Combine forward base in the Gannet Banks. Its depot hulk fuels every group still at sea. A heavy task group lies inside and a strike group is 10 minutes out. Mission: destroy the depot. Execution: strike fast and get clear before the strike group arrives. This ends the Combine's hold on the Banks.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: Sea trial

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: a Combine patrol boat is exercising in open water. Mission: sink or disable her. Execution: let the officers fight the ship and watch how they do it.
